landing.heroLede: Log in, buy a scratch ticket, pay at the club, then reveal your prize after the draw. One account for every club tombola.
landing.step1Text: Register once. The same account follows you from one tombola to the next: ceremonies, meetings, and other club events.
landing.step2Text: Choose how many tickets you want. Each ticket has a unique number, saved to your account.
landing.step3Text: Cash at the club, or Wave. Only paid tickets enter the draw.
landing.step4Text: After the draw, scratch the silver panel: a prize, or no prize. Find every tombola you joined in your account.
landing.donateText: You can also donate via Wave. Doaty Délice, affiliated with Rotaract IUGB Club, receives the payments.
